The '''17 kv anti-personnel blaster''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|multi-troop transports]] were equipped with four such weapons in ball turrets on the front of the vehicle.
